mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM member WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (email, password, name, member_type, org_reg_no, org_status, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{memberType}, #{orgRegNo}, #{orgStatus}, NOW())

if.test: type != null and type != '' and type != 'all'

where.if: AND (email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.update: UPDATE member SET deleted_at = NOW(), email = CONCAT('deleted_', member_id, '@deleted.local'), name = '탈퇴한 회원', password = '', refresh = NULL WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE member SET point_balance = point_balance + #{delta} WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE member SET point_balance = point_balance + #{delta} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.donation_id, c.title AS campaign_title, c.campaign_id, d.amount, d.donated_at FROM donation d JOIN member m ON d.member_id = m.member_id JOIN campaign c ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE m.email = #{email} ORDER BY d.donated_at DESC

SELECT d.donation_id, c.title AS campaign_title, c.campaign_id, d.amount, d.donated_at FROM donation d JOIN campaign c ON d.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE d.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY d.donated_at DESC
